selection_rule: Relevant recommendations per original debut year, with no fixed quota. One entry per distinct series or edition.

shows.title: Mr. Bean
shows.edition: Original live-action comedy, not the animated spin-off or standalone films.

shows.title: House of Cards
shows.edition: Original British television miniseries; not the later American adaptation.

shows.title: Blossom
shows.edition: Original American sitcom including the aired 1990 pilot; later seasons remain part of the same edition.

shows.title: The Crystal Maze
shows.edition: Original British game-show edition, six series; later revival does not repeat the original entry.

shows.title: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
shows.edition: Original live-action anthology record; the later separately indexed revival is not this entry.
shows.premiere_source_note: Cached broadcast source dates the pilot October 25, 1991; IMDb indexes the series from 1990. Both dates are within this decade. Resolve the exact first-airing conflict before treating the date as final.

shows.title: The Larry Sanders Show
shows.edition: Scripted workplace sitcom set around a fictional talk show.

shows.title: Mad About You
shows.edition: Original live-action sitcom including continuing revival seasons as one edition.

shows.title: Babylon 5
shows.edition: Original series including its feature-length 1993 pilot under the rule allowing feature-length episodes; individual seasons and side movies are not additional entries.

shows.title: Homicide: Life on the Street
shows.edition: Original television series; the standalone Homicide movie is excluded.

shows.title: Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman
Cracker
shows.edition: Original British series; later companion specials and the American remake do not create extra entries here.

shows.title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers
shows.edition: Original English-language live-action series, not the side movies, later separately titled Ranger series, or animation.

shows.title: The Secret World of Alex Mack
Pride and Prejudice
shows.edition: Episodic BBC television miniseries; standalone film adaptations are excluded.

shows.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
shows.edition: Regular television series beginning in 1995; the preceding standalone television movies are not extra catalogue entries.

shows.title: Goosebumps
shows.edition: Original 1995 live-action anthology, not theatrical films or later television adaptations.

shows.title: Mr. Show with Bob and David
Bruce's Price Is Right
shows.edition: Bruce Forsyth's distinct 1995 British revival; the original US series and other British hosts' versions are separate editions.

game_show_eligibility.assessment: Bruce Forsyth version alone has seven series; Crowther, Warman, and Pasquale versions are not combined.

shows.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch
shows.edition: Live-action 1996 sitcom, not the cartoons or the standalone television movie.

shows.title: Forensic Files
shows.edition: Original documentary series, initially titled Medical Detectives. The later title is part of this same series; Forensic Files II is a separate production.

shows.title: Buffy the Vampire Slayer
shows.edition: 1997 television series; the standalone 1992 movie is excluded.

shows.title: Ally McBeal
shows.edition: Original television series; the separately indexed half-hour recut Ally is not included as another recommendation.

shows.title: Midsomer Murders
shows.edition: One series edition starting with the 1997 pilot; later seasons do not create another entry.
shows.original_air_date_note: Includes the feature-length 1997 pilot; TVmaze indexes the later 1998 series launch.

shows.title: Lexx
shows.edition: One continuing English-language series including its initial feature-length serial instalments. IMDb has used more than one identifier for this series.
shows.original_air_date_note: The first broadcast is placed in 1997 by the programme records. Some IMDb headers index production as beginning in 1996; this series is listed once under its broadcast debut.

shows.title: The Odyssey
shows.edition: Two-part live-action television miniseries; not an animated series or a standalone film.

shows.title: Will & Grace
shows.edition: Original live-action sitcom including continuing revival seasons as one edition.

shows.title: From the Earth to the Moon
Merlin
shows.edition: Two-part live-action television miniseries, distinct from the later continuing British television series.

shows.title: Sports Night
shows.edition: Scripted workplace sitcom set around a fictional sports programme.

shows.title: Robot Wars
shows.edition: Original British robot-combat game-show edition, seven main series; later revivals are not repeated here.

shows.title: Scrapheap Challenge
shows.edition: Original British engineering competition, eleven series. Regional rebroadcasts under Junkyard Wars do not duplicate it.

shows.title: Farscape
shows.edition: English-language Australian-American co-production involving The Jim Henson Company and Hallmark. One series entry; no extra entry for a side movie.

shows.title: Family Feud
shows.edition: 1999 syndicated revival, originally hosted by Louie Anderson and later by Richard Karn, John O'Hurley, and Steve Harvey. Host changes do not create new entries.

game_show_eligibility.assessment: The 1999 syndicated revival itself exceeds five seasons; 1976 and 1988 editions are separate records.
